description:
Pay for a draft bounty's spots from your wallet. Call with dryRun first to see the total and your balance.
Use for: paying for a draft bounty.
Not for: paying a worker (pay_hire); adding a spot to a bounty that is already open (update_bounty); paying for one applicant on a bounty paid per hire (accept_application).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: fund_bounty({"bountyId":"b7Kq2mXw9TzR4nLp","dryRun":true})
Repeat: Once this has worked, a repeat does not do it again while that result still stands: it is refused, or answers with what is already there.
Errors: wallet_short, bounty_changed, already_funded, not_fundable, payment_processing, spending_limit_reached, account_setup_required; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

bountyId.description: The bounty id, or a pasted rentahuman.ai/bounties/... link.

dryRun.description: true returns the quote and takes nothing. A dry run shows the price, not whether the charge will be allowed. Default false.

name: fund_bounty

quote.description: Set on a dry run. Left out after a real call: a funded reply states no amount. The amount taken is the bounty's price at the moment of the charge, which can differ from an earlier dry run if the bounty was edited in between. Your wallet is the record of what was taken.

perSpot.description: Pay for one spot, including the most its bonuses can cost.

perSpotBonusMax.description: The bonus part of perSpot. It is already inside perSpot; never add it again.

platformCost.description: A cost the platform keeps, for example materials such as signs. 0 for most bounties.

serviceFee.description: The service fee: the fee on each spot, rounded per spot, plus the fee on platformCost.

shortfall.description: total minus walletBalance when the wallet does not cover it, else left out.

total.description: workerPay + serviceFee + platformCost. What a real call takes from the wallet.

walletBalance.description: Your balance when the quote was made.

workerPay.description: perSpot times spots: what is set aside for the workers.

title: Fund a bounty
